sources.role: official BigPEmu Linux x64 archive; official 64-bit FNV-1a C1B241BBFA5135CB
official Windows/Linux releases and hashes; current version 1.221
official configuration, input, UserData and state naming
official state paths and per-game naming

paths.path: BigPEmuConfig.bigpcfg in the OS-dependent application data folder; use the documented -localdata switch for a deterministic <install>/UserData/BigPEmuConfig.bigpcfg layout, or -cfgpath/-cfgpathabs for an explicit config.
evidence: docs:BigPEmu User Manual installation/data accessibility and command-line options

paths.path: Input settings are properties in BigPEmuConfig.bigpcfg or a per-game <image basename>.bigpcfg; configure through the Input menu, or preserve the text config and use -setcfgprop.
paths.naming: BigPEmu's .bigpcfg property syntax is category/property based; official manual documents GUI and -setcfgprop but no stable universal controller key list.
evidence: docs:BigPEmu User Manual Configuring Input, Per-Game Profiles and -setcfgprop

paths.path: UserData application folder (or <install>/UserData with -localdata) stores emulator EEPROM and other user data; game software images remain external.
paths.naming: Jaguar EEPROM is emulator-managed; official documentation does not promise one portable EEPROM filename across platforms.

paths.path: UserData application folder; -localdata relocates it beside the executable. Per-game states use the image hash in the filename when per-game states are enabled.
paths.naming: stateXXX.bigpstate, or gameXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX_YYY.bigpstate where X is the 64-bit FNV-1a image hash and Y is the slot.
evidence: docs:BigPEmu User Manual Data Accessibility and -localdata

paths.path: No external BIOS is required for ordinary Jaguar cartridges; custom boot ROM images are supported and selected through BigPEmu's System settings.
paths.naming: Custom boot ROM filename is user-selected; official documentation publishes no universal firmware name/checksum.
evidence: docs:BigPEmu home page (custom boot ROM images)

paths.path: No external decryption key file is documented for Jaguar cartridge/CD operation.

evidence: docs:BigPEmu User Manual (Windows config path and command-line options)

paths.path: BigPEmuConfig.bigpcfg or alongside the loaded image as <image>.bigpcfg; Input menu writes the per-device mapping properties.
paths.naming: Category/property .bigpcfg syntax; use official GUI or -setcfgprop rather than assuming generic SDL names.
evidence: docs:BigPEmu User Manual Configuring Input and Per-Game Profiles

paths.path: %APPDATA%\BigPEmu\UserData (or <install>\UserData with -localdata) contains EEPROM and user data; cartridge/CD images remain external.
paths.naming: EEPROM is emulator-managed; no cross-platform filename contract is published.
stateXXX.bigpstate; per-game mode: gameXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX_YYY.bigpstate (64-bit FNV-1a image hash plus slot).

paths.path: No ordinary BIOS file required; optional custom boot ROM image is selected in System settings.
paths.naming: User-selected custom boot ROM name; no universal canonical checksum.

linux-flatpak.reason: The official download page lists Windows and Linux archives but no BigPEmu Flatpak.

macos.reason: The official standalone desktop downloads list Windows and Linux; macOS is not listed as a current desktop archive.
